note: Adapted from Emerson's monograph on the termites of the Belgian Congo and the Cameroon; the original is in English. The original treats the species under the combination Termes (Termes) terricola Sjöstedt, based on a queen and a soldier; the species-level diagnosis compares it point by point with T. schmitzi, T. buchholzi, T. diana, T. latialatus and others, and that comparison has been merged into 'Diagnostic characters'.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The queen's head is narrower in the female than in T. schmitzi, and the pronotum is distinctly more angular; T. agilis is slightly larger; T. apollo is larger; in T. aurora the distance between the ocellus and the eye is greater than the length of the ocellus; it is hard to distinguish from the description of T. buchholzi, but in the latter the ocellus lies closer to the eye (0.11 mm); in T. diana the ocellus-eye distance is greater than its length; in the paratype of T. latialatus the ocellus lies closer to the eye (0.13 mm).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Queen's head yellowish brown, the base of each hair with a pale dot so that the head appears speckled; head oval, covered with rather long hairs; the fontanelle is a rather inconspicuous small dot in the middle of the head. Antennal segment 3 equal in length to segment 4, segment 2 larger than segment 3 or 4. Compound eyes medium-sized, not very close to the lower margin. Ocelli rather large, 0.267 mm wide, 0.33 mm long, 0.20 mm from the eye. Postclypeus less than half as long as wide, slightly paler than the head, with a mid-longitudinal line. Pronotum proportionally wide and short, the anterior margin evenly concave, the posterior margin nearly straight or weakly concave but without a notch, the sides nearly straight and strongly converging posteriorly; slightly paler than the head. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum nearly straight and slightly concave. The sides of the queen's abdomen have wart-like thickenings. Measurements: head length 3.00 mm, head width 2.67 mm, eye diameter 0.67 mm, pronotum length 1.17 mm, pronotum width 2.50 mm, queen body length 59.00 mm, queen abdomen width 10.00 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head red-yellow, rectangular, the sides nearly straight and parallel. Antennal segment 3 smaller than segment 4, segment 4 equal in length to segment 2. Eyes reduced, a black dot behind the antennal base. Mandibles proportionally short. Both the anterior and the posterior margins of the pronotum concave, the posterior more deeply so than the anterior. Measurements: head length 5.25 mm, head width 2.40 mm, pronotum length 0.79 mm, pronotum width 1.66 mm, hind tibia length 1.84 mm, left mandible length 1.65 mm.
